name: Bar Miller

menus.name: 15-course omakase
menus.note: Seatings at 6pm and 8:30pm; the pairing is seven wines and sakes; tax and a 20% gratuity are added

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, which shows tables up to 30 days ahead.
cancellation: Cancellations or changes less than 72 hours ahead are non-refundable, and the booking can't be moved to another date to avoid the charge. Private parties of six or more need a week's notice to cancel with a refund.
groups: Private seated dinners for up to eight; email info@barmiller.com.
dressCode: Business casual, according to its OpenTable listing.
byob: Corkage is $95 a bottle, arranged by email in advance.
